s1.summary: All twelve keys are correct and matched my own picks. Variant B is stronger: B-Q1 targets the most consequential operational effect (the default changed from codex to gms) with three realistic distractors, its 심화 explanations contrast old and new behavior, and its only weak item is B-심화3, which tests the pre-existing 422 failure contract (genericCs). s3.summary: All 12 stored keys match the independent picks. Variant B is clearly stronger: its stems do not state the deciding rule, its explanations contrast before and after behavior, and two of its three 심화 questions surface real defects in the change: a stalled chain after a result-less failed recovery job, and a budget reset when a queued-job merge drops recoveryAttempt. Variant A has five 심화 questions, but 심화3's stem gives the answer away, 심화2's stem hedge does the same, 심화4 is a padded hypothetical and 심화5 rests on a rare edge case; its explanations lead with CS definitions. In grading, B reuses the stored key text verbatim with precise pinpoint and credit, while A regenerates the 해설 and option notes for Q1, 심화1 and 심화2 (three disagreements with showanswer) and adds concept definitions; A's @hey replies also insert CS lectures into the lookup and wrong-premise answers, and its design reply has broken escaped markdown.
